fieldContext.note: Multi-perspective reviews require 3 distinct reviewer viewpoints: 1) Clients/Users (verify true wants/needs), 2) Requirements Specialists (verify clarity & standards compliance), and 3) Software Architects/Engineers (verify sufficiency for design & construction).

personalNotes: Providing checklists, quality criteria, or a 'Definition of Done' to reviewers guides focus away from typos and toward missing exception boundaries.
